name: gr-air-modes
summary: Gnuradio tools for receiving Mode S transponder signals, including ADS-B.
highlights: -l — GPS coordinates of receiving station in format xx.xxxxx,xx.xxxxx
-a — specify additional servers from which to take data in format tcp://x.x.x.x:y,tcp://....
-n — disable printing decoded packets to stdout
-K — filename for Google Earth KML output
-P — open an SBS-1-compatible server on port 30003
-m — FlightGear server to send aircraft data, in format host:port
-t — Open a TCP server on this port to publish reports
